answer.reason: The verses tell of Jacob setting up the stone he slept on as a pillar, anointing it, and declaring it God's house.

clauses.english: was set up by Jacob as a pillar and anointed with oil
clauses.quote: set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it

clauses.english: was declared by Jacob to be God's house
clauses.quote: this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house

doubts: GEN 35:14 tells of a pillar of stone set up later where God talked with Jacob; it may be a different pillar, so I left it out.
GEN 31:13 only recalls the anointed pillar, so I did not use it.
